flood.note: Unsupervised flood anomaly risk model combining weather and GEE satellite backscatter

earthquake.note: Assesses unusual seismic event distributions relative to local populations

heatwave.note: Temperature anomaly index detecting extreme meteorological departures

drought.note: Drought stress indicators. Limited by lack of 30-year historical baseline

cyclone.note: Coastal cyclone condition anomaly detector, measuring deviations in wind and pressure
